notes:
PA notes from 03/04 call - engineering and ops were very focused on latency and spike behavior. Wants streaming suggestions in agent UI (web) with <=120ms median suggestion latency and 95th <=250ms; current web socket stack ok but needs KV cache co-location. 
- Quote from CTO: 'If suggestions are slow or hallucinate we lose trust immediately.'
- Interested in tool-calling: open to Redwood function-call patterns to hit internal ticketing and knowledgebase (Zendesk -> internal mappings).
- Asked about model drift monitoring and tie-in to Redwood Optimize evals.
- Prefers dedicated pools or private control plane inside their VPC; strict data residency (US only) for voice transcripts and PII.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high; willing to commit if unit economics are predictable (want token-level cost breakdown per agent flow).
- Typical agent desktop concurrency target: 200 steady agents, expected peak bursts up to ~1,200 (payday/seasonal).
- Interested in automatic fallback to smaller model during cold-starts or degraded capacity.
- Security team flagged SOC2 + SSO + customer-managed KMS as must-haves for procurement to move forward.

requirements_summary: Real-time agent assist integrated into existing web agent UI. Streaming candidate suggestions, dynamic tool-calls into internal ticketing and KB, and asynchronous ticket summarization for after-call work. SLOs: median suggestion latency <=120ms, p95 <=250ms; cold-start fallback for scale events; persistent audit logs and SSO; regional data residency (US). Must support automated guardrails to prevent PHI leakage and allow moderators to tune policies.
technical_poc_notes: Week1: baseline latency test vs their websocket stack using 50 agents simulated
Week2: deploy dedicated Redwood pool in US-east, configure KV prefix caching for hot flows
Week3: integrate function-calling shim to Zendesk test sandbox; validate end-to-end tool call latency
Week4: spike test (scale to 1,200 concurrent agents), evaluate fallback and routing behavior; run Optimize suggestions and collect cost metrics
sla_targets: median <=120ms suggestion latency; p95 <=250ms; 99.9% uptime for dedicated pool; failover to alternative region with degraded model within 5s
routing_fallback: Prefer region-first routing (US-east primary) -> smaller quantized model fallback -> queued requests with progressive disclosure in UI
cost_sensitivity: medium-high; wants predictable committed pricing for dedicated pool plus per-call up/down scaling for bursts
spike_handling_expectations: Must handle sustained 10x bursts (200->1,200) with graceful degradation: degrade to condensed suggestions then to static KB hits; no full outage during business hours
guardrails_and_moderation: Require inline content filters for PII/PHI, customizable policy rules, audit trail per suggestion, human-in-the-loop override, and automatic suppression for flagged responses
